project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
Image user should not be 'root'
verdict: confirmed (high confidence, by operator): engine/Dockerfile defines no USER in any stage, so the image default is root; internal/engineclient/client.go:139-141 sets cfg.User only when the CLI is built for linux, so on the primary Windows dev platform the long-lived container and exec'd scanners run as root with the repository bind-mounted read-write; real hardening gap if a scan target escapes, only mitigated on Linux hosts
